meta.library: after-effects: 201 sources per caller (199 distinct title/author pairs in chunks_full.jsonl), 3,006 chunks; the 27 targeted sources are chunk ids 4962-5327 (366 chunks)
meta.rubric: 2 = an actionable answer somewhere in the 10 agent hits, readable enough to apply; 1 = partial; 0 = nothing. Causes for scores under 2: coverage / ranking / chunk. change_cause says why a score moved: new source (answer comes from the 27 added sources), wider results (answer was already in the library and now fits in ranks 6-10 or the 3-per-source cap), or both.
meta.method: Agent hits mapped to chunks_full ids by exact content (720/720 matched). Every previously-2 question still contains its previous best chunk, so all 41 stay 2; their new hits were skimmed for reinforcement. All 31 previously sub-2 questions were judged from the full text of every hit not in the old top 5, against must_contain and the previous notes. Coverage claims re-checked by regex over chunks_full.jsonl. Vector ranks for better_ids re-measured with eval/run_queries.py at top_k 40 for 16 questions (hybrid order equalled vector order in all 16). better_vector_ranks for questions outside those 16 are carried over from coverage_judgement.json.
